pages.title: Hospital
pages.text: Plays when you crash in worn-out pads: you are out of the race, and the hospital bill is yours. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Paramedics
pages.text: The ambulance crew is no comfort. One has heard of road pizza, 'but this looks more like road pasta!' Another checks your pockets for a credit card to cover the damages.

pages.title: Afterlife
pages.text: The Sega Channel sent Skitchin' down the cable in 1995-97, it was a top-5 Genesis rental at Blockbuster in 1997, and in 2017 GamesRadar named it the 49th best Mega Drive game.
